info.title: LogicMonitor
info.description: Trimmed LogicMonitor REST API for Rewst Custom Integration v2. Includes core device, alert, collector, SDT, and dashboard management endpoints. Uses Bearer token authentication - generate tokens via the LogicMonitor admin portal.
